03
OP IRON TIDE

SITUATION

OP IRON TIDE · HAMMERFALL · 19 October 2026
Time hack
__:__:__
Sitac · 03
Situation log
  1. 01An SA-6 battery, the GUARDIAN SA-6 Site, guards the airfield from the hills at 43°08'55"N 40°37'34"E (3 nm bearing 045 from Gudauta airfield). While its Straight Flush radar is up, nothing gets near Gudauta.
  2. 02The GUDAUTA Fuel and Ammunition Depot sits just north of the runway at 43°08'05"N 40°34'58"E (1 nm bearing 020 from Gudauta airfield): fuel bowsers and ammunition trucks that keep the MiGs and the coastal units supplied.
  3. 03Kill the radar and the airfield is open. Burn the depot and the NCF cannot rearm for another push.
Background

Operation IRON TIDE, Day 2. 19 October 2026, 09:00 local. Yesterday CTF-61 went after the NCF offensive at sea and on the road to Kutaisi (BREAKWATER). Today we take the fight to the airfield it came from. Gudauta is the NCF's forward base on the coast: its MiG-29s, its fuel and its ammunition all stage there.
